SELECT r.run_id, r.trigger_type, r.requested_by, u.email AS requested_by_email, r.region_code, r.status, r.skip_reason, r.success_count, r.fail_count, r.fallback_count, r.started_at, r.finished_at FROM tb_weather_refresh_run r LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = r.requested_by
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, r.run_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.call_id, c.run_id, r.trigger_type, c.region_code, c.provider_code, c.call_kind, c.fallback, c.http_status, c.success, c.error_code, c.error_message, c.duration_ms, c.response_bytes, c.called_at FROM tb_weather_call_log c JOIN tb_weather_refresh_run r ON r.run_id = c.run_id
ORDER BY c.called_at DESC, c.call_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT provider_code, count(*) AS calls FROM tb_weather_call_log WHERE called_at >= #{from} AND called_at < #{to} GROUP BY provider_code ORDER BY provider_code

SELECT count(*) AS calls, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) AS failures, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fallback) AS fallbacks, avg(duration_ms)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS avg_duration_ms FROM tb_weather_call_log WHERE called_at >= #{from} AND called_at < #{to}
